test_name: Audit and Accountability - AU-6 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Grants-Workflow-024
Primary NIST family: Audit and Accountability (AU); evidence focus: AU-6.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: organization-wide audit logging captures authentication, privilege, configuration, and data-access events. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
